item.title: Isaac’s Wells: Finding Room, Still Following God
item.description:
Read: Genesis 26:12–33

There is a phrase connected with my parents’ decision to move roughly 400 miles that has stayed with me: “The third well’s a gusher.” That move was a big thing for me as a child, and I remember the excitement. But I also remember the years before it, when my parents had been through illness, redundancy and times when we had very little. I remember seeing God’s provision throughout those years, and I remember how hard they were. There is no doubt about that.

item.title: If God Knows, Why Pray?
item.description:
After hours · a continuing series

Late Night Questions

My wife is a midwife, and some of the more difficult theological and ethical questions in our house have a habit of arriving after a late shift, usually when we're both tired and neither of us is expecting a theological discussion.

This series is an attempt to keep track of those questions: not necessarily to find a neat answer, but to look at Scripture, draw on writers who have helped me think, and work out what I actually believe and why.
